title: Currently Undergoing Sadesati
content:

Phase: Third / Final Phase

Saturn transits the 2nd house from the Moon.

Sade Sati began: 24 January 2020.

Expected completion: 23 February 2028.

2. Meena Rashi (Pisces)

Phase: Second / Peak Phase

Saturn transits the Moon sign itself (1st house).

Sade Sati began: 29 April 2022.

Expected completion: 17 April 2030.

3. Mesha Rashi (Aries)

Phase: First / Rising Phase

Saturn transits the 12th house from the Moon.

Sade Sati began: 29 March 2025.

Expected completion: 31 May 2032.

UPCOMING SADE SATI 4. Vrishabha Rashi (Taurus)

Phase: First / Rising Phase

Saturn will enter Aries, the 12th house from Taurus.

Initial entry: 3 June 2027.

Temporary interruption: 20 October 2027.

Sade Sati resumes: 23 February 2028.

Expected completion: 13 July 2034.

title: Mars in Leo | 12th November 2026
content:
1. Mesha Rashi (Aries):

Mars transits the 5th house

This transit may bring increased ambition, courage and determination in matters related to education, creativity and personal goals. Students may experience greater competitive drive, but impatience and lack of concentration could affect academic performance. Romantic relationships may experience sudden disagreements or emotional distance. Avoid impulsive decisions in speculative investments and matters involving children. This period can also encourage deeper interest in spirituality, mantra and traditional knowledge.

2. Vrishabha Rashi (Taurus):

Mars transits the 4th house

Domestic matters may become more demanding, with the possibility of disagreements within the family, particularly concerning property, assets or household responsibilities. There may be a strong desire to purchase a vehicle, renovate a home or make changes to living arrangements. However, avoid rushing into property-related decisions. Maintain patience with your mother and other family members. Emotional restlessness and disturbances in domestic peace may require attention.

3. Mithuna Rashi (Gemini):

Mars transits the 3rd house

This transit may increase courage, initiative and the willingness to take calculated risks. You may become more determined to pursue professional goals, independent projects and new opportunities. Communication could become unusually direct, creating misunderstandings with siblings, colleagues or neighbours. Short-distance travel and networking may increase. Channel your energy into productive activities and avoid unnecessary arguments or impulsive decisions.

4. Karka Rashi (Cancer):

Mars transits the 2nd house

Financial matters and family responsibilities may require additional attention. There could be unexpected expenses, disagreements over money or differences of opinion within the family. Your speech may become more aggressive or straightforward, potentially affecting personal relationships. Exercise caution while making financial commitments and avoid impulsive purchases. Pay attention to eating habits and maintain a balanced approach towards savings and expenditure.

5. Simha Rashi (Leo):

Mars transits the 1st house

This is an intense transit for Leo natives, as Mars, Ketu and Jupiter occupy your Moon sign. You may experience a strong desire to establish yourself, take charge and pursue ambitious goals. However, the conjunction of Mars and Ketu may create impatience, impulsive behaviour and uncertainty regarding personal direction. Relationships may experience ego clashes or sudden misunderstandings. Give importance to physical well-being, emotional balance and thoughtful decision-making. Spiritual inclination and interest in self-discovery may also increase.

6. Kanya Rashi (Virgo):

Mars transits the 12th house

Expenses may increase, particularly in connection with travel, healthcare, accommodation or personal responsibilities. Sleep patterns and mental peace may require attention. Some natives may explore foreign opportunities, relocation or professional assignments away from their usual environment. Avoid unnecessary financial commitments and be cautious about confidential matters. This transit can also encourage spiritual practices, meditation and introspection.

7. Tula Rashi (Libra):

Mars transits the 11th house

This transit may increase your ambitions and determination to achieve long-term financial and professional goals. New opportunities may emerge through professional networks, influential individuals and social connections. However, disagreements with friends, colleagues or elder siblings may arise due to differences in expectations. Be selective about partnerships and avoid allowing financial ambitions to influence important personal relationships. Focus on realistic goals rather than quick gains.

8. Vrishchika Rashi (Scorpio):

Mars transits the 10th house

Career and professional responsibilities may become a major focus during this transit. You may feel motivated to pursue leadership opportunities, take independent decisions or establish your professional identity. However, the Mars–Ketu combination may create sudden changes in professional priorities, disagreements with authority figures or dissatisfaction with existing responsibilities. Avoid impulsive career decisions and maintain professionalism during workplace conflicts. This period can be productive when ambition is channelled with discipline.

9. Dhanu Rashi (Sagittarius):

Mars transits the 9th house

Matters related to higher education, long-distance travel, religious beliefs and professional learning may become prominent. You may develop a stronger desire to explore new philosophies, pursue advanced studies or travel for personal and professional reasons. Differences of opinion with your father, teachers or mentors may arise. Avoid becoming rigid about your beliefs and exercise caution while undertaking long journeys. This period may also encourage deeper spiritual exploration.

10. Makara Rashi (Capricorn):

Mars transits the 8th house

This transit may bring greater attention to joint finances, investments, inheritance, taxes and other shared responsibilities. Unexpected developments may require you to reassess financial arrangements or existing commitments. Avoid taking unnecessary risks, engaging in speculative activities or making decisions without adequate information. Be cautious while handling machinery, sharp objects and physically demanding activities. This period can also encourage research, occult studies and deeper investigation into hidden subjects.

11. Kumbha Rashi (Aquarius):

Mars transits the 7th house

Relationships, marriage and business partnerships may require additional patience and understanding. Differences of opinion, ego clashes and impulsive reactions could create tension between partners. Those involved in business partnerships should maintain transparency in financial and professional dealings. Avoid making major relationship decisions in moments of anger. For unmarried natives, this period may bring intense relationship developments, but careful assessment of compatibility and intentions is important.

12. Meena Rashi (Pisces):

Mars transits the 6th house

This transit may strengthen your competitive spirit and determination to overcome professional challenges, workplace obstacles and existing disputes. You may become more proactive in handling debts, pending responsibilities and difficult situations. However, workplace disagreements and conflicts with colleagues should be handled diplomatically. Pay attention to health routines, stress management and physical safety. This can be a productive period for competitive examinations, resolving disputes and addressing long-standing responsibilities.
